jsonld_raw.name: (130 G) LEMON CANDIED SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made of vegetable wax.

Lemon Candied | This fragrance evokes the warmth of a freshly baked lemon tart, where candied lemon meets the delicate charm of orange blossom, sweetened with rich brown sugar and creamy panna cotta, all wrapped in a comforting embrace of vanilla.

Notes:
Top: candied lemon, orange peel.
Heart: panna cotta, brown sugar.
Base: smoked sandalwood, amber.

The candle comes in a cylindrical jar with a lid and a striped cover with a drawstring closure.
